info.title: Erupt
info.description:
REST API of the erupt framework: every endpoint the admin UI calls, usable by any client.

**Authentication.** `POST /erupt-api/login` returns a token (`token` field when `pass` is true). Server-to-server callers use `GET /erupt-api/open-api/create-token` with an appid and secret instead. Send the token in the `token` request header. Endpoints opened by the browser or by an editor (template pages, editor uploads) cannot set headers and take the same value as the `_token` query parameter. An expired or missing token answers 401, a missing menu or erupt permission answers 403.

**The `erupt` header.** Data, build, component, file and export endpoints are scoped to one `@Erupt` class. The `erupt` header carries its simple class name and must match the `{erupt}` path segment, or name the parent erupt when the path addresses a nested erupt (tab, sub-form, reference).

**Errors.** Business errors come back as HTTP 500 with an `R` body: `success` is false, `message` holds the text to show and `promptWay` tells the UI how to show it.

post.summary: Sign in with account and password.
post.description: When erupt-app.pwd-transfer-encrypt is on the password is sent base64-encoded three times. After repeated failures useVerifyCode turns true and the captcha from code-img must be sent as verifyCode/verifyCodeMark. When the user has an authenticator bound, pass is false, mfaRequired is true and the returned mfaTicket must be exchanged through login-mfa.

post.summary: Second step of a two factor login.
post.description: Exchanges the mfaTicket from login plus a one-time code (or a recovery code) for a session. An ordinary wrong code keeps the ticket alive.

post.description: Passwords follow the same transfer encoding as login.

post.summary: Save the form view.
post.description: Runs field-level validation (which also fires DataProxy.validate) and then delegates the entire persistence action to DataProxy.formSave. No database CRUD is invoked by the framework, so file-backed or API-backed form views are first-class. Throwing EruptException from formSave aborts the save with a user-visible message.
